title: Slow Down, Think Deeply
coreMove: Slow thinking is not delay; it is the small gap where you check the stimulus, test your first response, and make later speed safer for people who depend on you.

exampleSpecs.audience: team leads facing a fast blame cycle
exampleSpecs.stakes: a rushed reply could protect pride but damage trust
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A genuine two-bad-options choice happens at a butcher paper station.

exampleSpecs.audience: small operators under visible customer pressure
exampleSpecs.stakes: fast pricing could turn one bad crate into a bad table
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Two named people talk at a farmers market stall and the lesson emerges in the exchange.

exampleSpecs.audience: readers who react fast inside family tension
exampleSpecs.stakes: a false accusation could turn a small scare into a fight
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: The bathroom medicine cabinet sets up an expectation, then reveals a quieter truth.

exampleSpecs.stakes: trying to fix everything at once could wreck the next set
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A short message exchange at a tennis court net post compresses the lesson.

exampleSpecs.stakes: one blind dispatch could send crews the wrong way
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A routine at an ambulance dispatch station is interrupted and restarted differently.

exampleSpecs.stakes: a rushed cut wastes material and hides the lesson
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A small lived moment at a carpentry workbench teaches through detail.
